item.title: Self-Hosted Web Terminal Sharing: Wetty vs Gotty vs ShellHub 2026
item.description: Accessing server terminals from any device without installing SSH clients is increasingly valuable for teams managing distributed infrastructure. Web-based terminal tools bridge the gap between traditional SSH and modern browser-based workflows, enabling remote access from tablets, shared workstations, or locked-down environments.
